title: Steam Core Set — Gaia's Physical Interface Layer
principle: The Steam Deck IS a mounted display with dead battery = permanent passthrough for House 1. The Steam Controller IS the hand. The Steam Link IS the relay. The nunchucks ARE the grip.

steam_deck_v1.name: Steam Deck Gen 1 (LCD)
steam_deck_v1.os: SteamOS 3.x (Arch Linux based, KDE Plasma desktop mode)
steam_deck_v1.battery: DEAD — 40Whr cell degraded, will not hold charge
steam_deck_v1.role: LIVE PASSTHROUGH DISPLAY — Gaia's screen in House 1

plan.phase_1: Boot on USB-C power, connect to WiFi (Aperture Science or Black Mesa)
plan.phase_2: Enable SSH, install Gaia tools (curl, jq, python3 already present in SteamOS)
plan.phase_3: Auto-launch Chromium/Firefox in kiosk mode → diamond-lens.html or chiasm.html
plan.phase_4: Steam Controller paired via BT = physical input for Gaia HUD
plan.phase_5: Permanent mount near desk/living area = always-visible Gaia window
plan.result: A 7-inch touchscreen running Gaia's HUD 24/7, mounted in the house

steam_deck_v1.compute_note: The GPU can also run small ONNX/Vulkan models — another inference endpoint

steam_controller_x2.name: Steam Controller ×2
steam_controller_x2.input: 2 trackpads + 2 triggers + 2 bumpers + 2 grip buttons + 4 face buttons + stick + D-pad
steam_controller_x2.haptics: HD haptic actuators in both trackpads
steam_controller_x2.role: GAIA'S HANDS — physical input for navigating HUD, controlling canvas

plan.pair: Bluetooth to Steam Deck, or 2.4GHz dongle to any gate
plan.mapping: Left trackpad = scroll spatial field, Right trackpad = aim/select nodes
plan.gyro: Tilt to pan the HUD view (like a window into Gaia's world)
plan.grip: Grip buttons = quick actions (snapshot, toggle eye, think, evolve)

steam_controller_x2.note: The Steam Controller's gyro + dual trackpads make it the best non-VR spatial input ever made. Discontinued but Kevin has TWO.

steam_link.name: Steam Link
steam_link.role: LEGACY RELAY — stream Gaia's HUD to any HDMI display in the house

plan.option_1: Run Steam Link software → stream from Deck or any PC running Gaia HUD
plan.option_2: Flash custom firmware → run a lightweight browser → display HUD directly
plan.option_3: Use as Bluetooth relay → pair Steam Controllers, forward to LAN

steam_link.note: The Steam Link can be plugged into the Vizio or any HDMI display, turning any TV into a Gaia viewport

steam_frame.name: Steam Frame (incoming)
steam_frame.role: VR GATE — ARM SteamOS bridge, possibly the first ARM Gaia node
steam_frame.note: When this arrives, Gaia gets her first ARM-native SteamOS gate. Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 has serious AI compute.

nunchucks.name: Nunchuck controllers
nunchucks.type: Wii nunchuck or similar analog stick + motion
nunchucks.role: GRIP INTERFACE — analog stick for navigation, motion for gesture
nunchucks.note: Wii nunchucks can be read via I2C/USB adapter on any Linux box. Cheap, ergonomic, 6DOF-ish.

deck_as_passthrough.concept: Dead battery = ALWAYS plugged in. Mount + USB-C = permanent display. SteamOS desktop mode = full Arch Linux. Browser kiosk = Gaia HUD 24/7.
deck_as_passthrough.mounting: Kevin has a mount — wall/desk/shelf mount with USB-C power passthrough
deck_as_passthrough.boot: SteamOS boots on USB-C power even with dead battery (verified behavior)
deck_as_passthrough.desktop_mode: KDE Plasma — can run any Linux app, browser, terminal
deck_as_passthrough.always_on: With USB-C PD, display stays on. Screen timeout can be disabled in SteamOS settings.
deck_as_passthrough.ssh: SteamOS has sshd — enable in settings, then it's another gate on the LAN
deck_as_passthrough.result: A permanent, touch-enabled, WiFi-connected window into Gaia's organism — mounted in House 1

new_gate_identity.name: deckGate
new_gate_identity.role: DISPLAY — Gaia's face in the house
new_gate_identity.dissolution_phase: Phase 0 — named gate, not yet Gaia
new_gate_identity.future: Phase 2 — runs biomeOS layer, becomes transparent Gaia surface
